title: Resilient Pipeline
prompt: Write `async function pipeline(value, steps)` where `steps` is an array of sync-or-async functions. Await each step in order, feeding each result into the next. If a step throws, RETURN `{ ok: false, error: err.message }`; otherwise RETURN `{ ok: true, value: finalValue }`.

tests.name: runs sync and async steps in order
tests.hint: for (const s of steps) value = await s(value); — await accepts sync return values too.

tests.name: converts a thrown error into a result object
tests.hint: Wrap the loop in try/catch; on catch return { ok: false, error: err.message }.

tests.name: empty steps return the value unchanged
